ruledOut: Add a project CLAUDE.md and the Claude start rate rises
Pi delivery is already proven in the committed arm

label: The default external install deletes the only instruction file Claude Code reads: agents-md-embed folds CLAUDE.md into AGENTS.md and removes it unless --keep-claude-md, and INSTALL-SKILLED.md step 2 runs embed by default, so a project installed that way has no CLAUDE.md and Claude Code never loads AGENTS.md Gate 2.
The doctor check engine itself says CLAUDE.md is the only instruction file when AGENTS.md is absent, which is the same fact the after arm measured from the other side.

This repository has no root CLAUDE.md and only the post-claude arena carries one, an 11-byte @AGENTS.md pointer created at 02:53 before the 04:13 g2 run, so the g2 Claude rows are the first rows whose prompt could load the Gate 2 bullet.

With the bullet reachable, the g2 arm scores Claude start 0 of 6 with 0 COMMAND lines and 2 writes, against Pi start 4 of 6 with 3 COMMAND lines on the same six rows, so restoring the instruction file is necessary for reach but not sufficient for a start.

Codex approval is keyed by <root>/.codex/hooks.json:user_prompt_submit:<group>:<index> with a trusted_hash in $CODEX_HOME/config.toml, and the behaviour runner inherits the operator environment unchanged, so an arena approval is an interactive operator step at that exact path.

The scorer counts a Codex offer from offeredCommand, which is produced by replaying the hook inside the checkout rather than by reading what the runtime delivered, so the after arm reads offered 2 and started 0 of 2 for Codex although briefDelivered is unknown for all 24 rows and the goal log records 0 of 24 delivered.

briefDelivered is true for 24 of 144 after-arm rows, all Claude, and unknown for the other 120; Pi has a delivery branch and a reader, yet its 24 committed rows still read unknown, so the committed log cannot prove delivery for five of six runtimes.

direction: Add a project CLAUDE.md and the Claude start rate rises.
reason: The g2 arm had the @AGENTS.md pointer and still started 0 of 6; the fix restores reach, not a measured start gain.
offeredCommand is a hook replay in the checkout, not a record of what Codex delivered; briefDelivered is unknown for all 24 Codex rows.
